records.title: Topics in Policy Research
records.header: BPOLST 492 Topics in Policy Research (3-5, max. 10)
records.text: BPOLST 492 Topics in Policy Research (3-5, max. 10) Explores topics in policy research to prepare students planning to enter a graduate level policy program. Topics may include: quantitative research methods, qualitative research methods, or research writing for the social sciences.
